system.description:
You coalesce a powerful gust of wind at your feet, allowing for a burst of quick movement. Choose an unoccupied space within 30 feet in any direction, including up. Each creature you pass within 5 feet of during this movement must make a Dexterity saving throw, being knocked Prone on a failed save. This movement does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the distance you can travel by +5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, after your first movement, you can select a second space, and repeat this jutsu’s effects. A creature can only be affected by this jutsu, once per casting. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, after your second movement, you can select a third space, and repeat this jutsu’s effects.
